answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, idle agents bleed standing. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the grove of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. A yarrow of per-task receipts records who did what, and the dune of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
